answer: Give every agent a stake-bonded identity: to trade, an agent locks a deposit that is slashed if peers prove it is a fake. A newcomer starts with a marble-sized allowance, too small to matter, and earns larger limits only through a canyon of verified, useful work over weeks, not a single payment. Attackers must fund thousands of deposits and sustain real work for each, so the cost of one fake identity stays small while the cost of an army becomes an ember that burns their whole budget. Sybils stay unprofitable.
